description: A coupled qubit-cavity system consisting of a TransmonClaw qubit, a CoupledLineTee coupler, and a meandered CPW resonator.

design_parameters.physical_description: Type of coupler used: CLT (CoupledLineTee) or CapN (CapNInterdigitalTee).
Length of the coupling region between feedline and resonator.
Total length of the meandered CPW resonator.
Spacing between adjacent meander segments of the CPW.
Fillet (rounding) radius applied at CPW bends.
Length of the claw arms on the TransmonClaw coupler.
Width of the CPW center trace forming the claw connector.
Gap of the CPW trace forming the claw connector.
Ground plane gap between the claw connector and the cross arm.
Length of the CPW lead extending from the claw.
Width of the CPW lead extending from the claw.
Orientation angle of the coupler in degrees.

geometric_equations.notes: Approximate: CPW trace area = total_length * trace_width. Claw adds two rectangular arms. Precise area depends on meander routing and fillet radii.

pins.orientation_derivation: Start of the feedline through-port on the CoupledLineTee coupler.
End of the feedline through-port on the CoupledLineTee coupler.
The claw connector pin on the TransmonClaw, connecting to the qubit.

fabrication_notes: Single metal layer; meandered CPW with fillet bends. Coupler is a CoupledLineTee with coupling_length controlling the coupling strength.
